verdict.rationale: Mixpanel markets AI 'Agents' that continuously monitor product metrics and surface anomalies (e.g., 'Signups dipped 19%…') and promises insights 'before you think to ask,' which implies proactive alerting, but the evidence never documents a concrete dashboard-subscription or alert-threshold/notification feature (e.g., email/Slack alert setup, subscribing to a specific dashboard). missing for 10: explicit alert-configuration/subscription docs, notification channel details, and confirmation the alerting works on dashboards specifically rather than just AI-agent summaries.
